card.desc: A fast pan, a swung object, a wipe between shots.
card.prompt: a thick length of rope swung fast past a microphone once, air rushing, rising then falling in pitch as it passes, dry, no impact at the end, no reverb
card.negative: music, tonal, speech, impact, hit, thud, reverb
card.note: Deliberately ends with no hit so you can place impact_hit on the frame you choose. If a seed comes back with a thump on the tail, trim it off rather than keeping it - a baked-in hit locks you to the model's timing instead of your cut.
